g.text: Heartbeat file and exec liveness probe (evilflowers-worker#11, 2026-11-20)
start: create_app() adds the Heartbeat consumer step (requires Tasks)
healthy, even during a 2 h task
main process frozen: deadlock, blocked event loop, kill -STOP
Threshold = 3 x interval (90 s). The solo pool runs tasks on the event loop and would trip the probe; a broker outage
longer than the threshold also stops the touches (the consumer blocks while it reconnects). An unwritable path is logged once.
